sloka: बभूव ह्यस्य हृदते चिन्ता सुमहती तदा ।त्वरया चापि दूतानाम् स्वप्नस्यापि च दर्शनात् ॥२-७०-२५॥
transliteration: babhūva hyasya hṛdate cintā sumahatī tadā ।tvarayā cāpi dūtānām svapnasyāpi ca darśanāt ॥2-70-25॥

translations.english: Then his heart was filled with extreme anxiety due to the haste of the messengers to depart and also due to the dream he had.
